title: Early GIRDER Arrow owner report on delivery and assembly
publisher: XHS public post; publisher authority unverified
notes: A self-described new owner reports paying a little over CNY 10,000 for an Arrow with carbon frame, carbon wheels, integrated carbon bar and a Shimano 105 group, and says the delivered bicycle required derailleur installation and shop adjustment. This is a single historical community report, not a universal shipping policy or proof of the later PF/Di2 package. The post does not identify electronic versus mechanical shifting, frame generation, size, a measured weight or maximum clearance. Subjective favorable ride impressions are not comparative stiffness evidence. Captured comments are partial; unanswered questions do not establish missing specifications.

reference_claims.claim: One 2023 Arrow owner reported arranging shop assembly and adjustment after delivery.
reference_claims.limitations: Pre-2025 owner report; trim and frame standards unknown. Confirm assembly requirements with the exact current seller; no general defect or shipping-policy finding.

capture.scope: Validated exact-query detail archive; public text reviewed. Raw posts, account identifiers and media remain local outside Git. No product-image or measured-weight pixel claim is made.
